# Cohorte

> > Cohorte provides AI strategy, custom systems, and professional training for leaders through the proprietary LUMEN Framework™.

Cohorte is an AI education and consulting platform serving enterprise leaders and professionals. The company combines live bootcamp training, a private community of 10,000+ members, and custom AI system development through its agency offering.

## Key Topics

- LUMEN Framework™
- AI strategy
- Generative AI
- Professional development
- Leadership development
- 8-week bootcamp
- Live cohorts
- Agentic workflows
- Custom AI systems
- Hands-on projects
- AI Friends community
- Career advancement
- Professional learning
- Bootcamp courses
- AI training

## Core Programs

- [The AI for Professionals Bootcamp](https://www.cohorte.co/bootcamp): 8-week live bootcamp teaching the LUMEN Framework™ for comprehensive AI mastery with hands-on projects and live cohorts.
- [AI Bootcamps & Learning Tracks](https://www.cohorte.co/learning-tracks): Specialized learning tracks in Productivity, Sales, Data, and Marketing for targeted professional development.

## Services & Consulting

- [Cohorte AI Agency](https://www.cohorte.co/agency): Enterprise consulting for custom AI systems and agentic workflows designed for organizational needs.

## Community & Resources

- [AI Friends Community](https://www.cohorte.co/community): Free private community of 10,000+ professionals sharing AI workflows, strategies, and best practices.

## About Cohorte

- [Cohorte Homepage](https://www.cohorte.co): Cohorte's main hub for AI strategy, custom systems, and bootcamp training for leaders.
